title: Patient Payment Plan Late Fee Share After a Failed Automatic Draft
content:
**Training questions — the lapse share of a Patient Payment Plan missed-installment late fee**

**What is the lapse share?**
A lapse share applies to a patient with at least 6 installments collected by automatic payment within the last 12 months, by the reason the latest failed automatic draft for the missed installment gave: where the card had expired or the account was closed the share is 0.5; where the funds were insufficient or the card was declined the share is 0.8; for every other patient the lapse share is one. The missed-installment late fee is multiplied by the lapse share.

**Which draft is read?**
The latest failed automatic payment entry on the plan carrying the due date of the missed installment the fee is for. Its recorded reason is one of: card expired, account closed, insufficient funds, card declined.

**Which collections count toward the 6?**
Installments received through automatic payment on the plan whose receipt is recorded within the last 12 months. An entry falls within the last 12 months when fewer than 12 whole calendar months separate the date it was recorded from the handling date.

## Table of shares

| Reason given by the latest failed automatic draft for the missed installment | 6 or more automatic collections within the last 12 months | 5 or fewer automatic collections within the last 12 months |
|---|---|---|
| Card expired | 0.5 | 1 |
| Account closed | 0.5 | 1 |
| Insufficient funds | 0.8 | 1 |
| Card declined | 0.8 | 1 |
| No failed automatic draft for that installment | 1 | 1 |

## Hypothetical cases

- A missed installment whose latest failed draft gave "card expired", on a plan with 7 automatic collections in the last 12 months: the share is 0.5.
- The same reason with exactly 6 collections: the share is 0.5 (6 is "at least 6"). With 5 collections: the share is one.
- A latest failed draft giving "insufficient funds", with 9 collections: the share is 0.8.
